Name: DE-Users
Statement:
-- +CUSTOMFIELDS(Skill.Module.BusinessObjects.User)
with
cli as
(
    select  UserId,
            string_agg(cast(Client as nvarchar(max)), ', ') as Clients,
            string_agg(cast(ClientId as nvarchar(max)), ', ') as ClientIds
    from    (
                select  distinct
                        ccu.[User] as UserId,
                        cli.Id as ClientId,
                        cli.Name as Client
                from    CommercialClientUser ccu
                            join ClientLookup cli on cli.Id = ccu.CommercialClient
            ) t
    group by UserId
)
select  usr.Oid as DocumentOid,
        usr.Oid as UserId,
        usr.Name as [User],
        usr.HasImage as UserHasImage,
        usl.IsActive as IsActive,
        dep.Oid as DepartmentId,
        dep.Name as Department,
        div.Oid as DivisionId,
        div.Name as Division,
        com.Oid as CompanyId,
        com.Name as Company,
        com.HasImage as CompanyHasImage,
        utp.Oid as TypologyId,
        utp.Name as Typology,
        utg.Oid as TypologyGroupId,
        utg.Name as TypologyGroup,
        ust.Oid as TypeId,
        ust.Name as Type,
        cou.Oid as CountryId, 
        cou.Name as Country,
        usr.HireDate as HireDate,
        usr.StartDate,
        usr.ExpirationDate as TerminationDate,
        usl.InactivatedOnUtc,
        usr.Mail as Email,
        usr.SsoUserName,
        usr.AdUserName,
        usl.UserName,
        usr.RequiredHours,
        com.RequiredHours as CompanyRequiredHours,
        usr.HourlyValue,
        usr.City as CityId,
        usr.CreatedOn,
        usr.ModifiedOn,
        usr.TaxPayerNumber,
        usr.ExternalId,
        usr.IsClient,
        usr.TimesheetRequired as IsTimesheetRequired,
        usr.SsoOnly,
        usr.Approver as IsApprover,
        res.Id as ResponsibleId,
        res.Name as Responsible,
        res.HasImage as ResponsibleHasImage,
        cli.ClientIds,
        cli.Clients,
        usr.DaysUntilBlocked,
        usr.Saturday as IsWorkingOnSaturday,
        usr.Sunday as IsWorkingOnSunday,
        usr.Monday as IsWorkingOnMonday,
        usr.Tuesday as IsWorkingOnTuesday,
        usr.Wednesday as IsWorkingOnWednesday,
        usr.Thursday as IsWorkingOnThursday,
        usr.Friday as IsWorkingOnFriday
from    [User] usr
            join Department dep on dep.Oid = usr.Department
            join Division div on div.Oid = dep.Division
            join Company com on com.Oid = div.Company
            join UserTypology utp on utp.Oid = usr.Typology
            left join UserTypologyGroup utg on utg.Oid = utp.UserTypologyGroup
            left join UserType ust on ust.Oid = usr.UserType
            join UserLookup usl on usl.Id = usr.Oid
            left join Country cou on cou.Oid = usr.Country
            left join cli on cli.UserId = usr.Oid
            left join UserLookup res on res.Id = usr.Responsible
